pride_data.title: Analysis of cross-link on Tranaldolase
pride_data.projectDescription: analysis of cross link on tranaldolase using mass spectrometry
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: The samples were digested using trypsin followed by clean up. The resulted peptides were analysed using LC-MS/
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: The raw data were processed via MaxQuant softwares using the following settings: fully specific trypsin digestion, maximum two missed cleavages, mass tolerance for precursors and fragment ions of 10 and 20 ppm, respectively, methionine oxidation as a variable modification, and target FDR as 1%. Protein database: the reviewed protein sequences from Neisseria gonorrhoeae were downloaded from Uniprot. The amino acid sequences of Transaldolase from Wild Type, K8A mutate and C38S mutate samples were added to the protein database. Dependent peptide search was activated.
